key_insight: Transverse liquid n-heptane jets can effectively initiate and stabilize oblique detonation waves in a confined combustor.
engineering_relevance: Understanding the dynamics of oblique detonation waves has significant implications for advanced propulsion systems and combustion technologies.
method: Computational investigation of jet-to-inflow momentum ratio (J)
Analysis of various jet strengths and their effects on detonation wave formation
Dynamic-stabilization mapping through phase-dependent combustion mode transitions
evidence_signal: The study shows that a moderate jet can create a standing detonation wave system, while excessive jet momentum destabilizes the ODW.
watch_item: Care must be taken with jet momentum levels, as excessive input can lead to instability and loss of detonation control.
paper_title: Liquid-fueled Oblique Detonation Stabilized by a Transverse Jet
